description: Jivo Group — Control Panel: strictly READ-ONLY CLI over the internal Django ERP/analytics dashboard for JIVO Wellness (sales realise, targets, order-in-hand, receivables aging, master data, inventory & production). Live production system — read/pull endpoints only.

tools.name: accounts_aging-beverages
tools.description: Beverages A/R aging as a pre-bucketed pivot (grouped by salesperson) with KPIs and totals. Optional: as_of.

params.name: as_of
params.description: Age balances to this date (YYYY-MM-DD; default today).

tools.name: accounts_aging-mart
tools.description: Mart A/R aging as a pre-bucketed pivot by Format with book KPIs and totals. Optional: as_of.

params.name: as_of
params.description: Age balances to this date (YYYY-MM-DD; default today).

tools.name: accounts_aging-oil
tools.description: Oil company open A/R ledger as a flat per-open-invoice list (aged to as_of). Optional: as_of.

params.name: as_of
params.description: Age balances to this date (YYYY-MM-DD; default today).

tools.name: accounts_claims
tools.description: Full claim register (hand-maintained customer claims) plus the customer master picklist.

tools.name: accounts_open-payments
tools.description: Customer payments on account (receipts not yet applied to invoices) for a date range. Required: start_date, end_date.

tools.name: credit_required-limit
tools.description: Required credit limits per ASM (Total Outstanding + 2%), lock state, as-of date — read from the page's embedded JSON.

tools.name: inventory_daily-production
tools.description: Standard work-order (OWOR) production transactions for a date range — planned vs completed, warehouse, status, user. Optional: start, end.

tools.name: inventory_non-moving
tools.description: Every in-stock finished good with ageing / movement signals (DaysInStock, DaysSinceMoved, last customer, qty/litres/value). Optional: schema.

tools.name: inventory_non-moving-drill
tools.description: Per-warehouse breakdown of a single finished good (code, name, qty, lot production date). Required: schema, item. Optional: whs.

params.name: item
params.description: SAP FG ItemCode to drill, e.g. FG0000441.

params.name: whs
params.description: Comma-separated warehouse codes to restrict to (optional).

tools.name: inventory_production-feasibility
tools.description: Read-only feasibility check for one FG at a requested qty: max producible count + per-component sufficiency (no production occurs). Required: fg_code. Optional: qty, warehouses.

params.name: fg_code
params.description: FG code to check, e.g. FG0000149.

params.name: warehouses
params.description: ALL or comma-separated warehouse codes ('Stock from' selection).

tools.name: inventory_production-fg-list
tools.description: Catalogue of manufacturable finished goods (those with a BOM) for the production-plan picker.

tools.name: inventory_production-warehouses
tools.description: Full warehouse master (code + name) for the 'Stock from' selector.

tools.name: inventory_reconciliation
tools.description: Wellness-Mart inter-company billing chains (PO -> SO -> GRPO -> A/P -> A/R) classified MATCHED/MISMATCH/INCOMPLETE. Optional: schema, date_from, date_to.

params.name: date_from
params.description: Window start (YYYY-MM-DD, optional; server default ~last 3 months).

params.name: date_to
params.description: Window end (YYYY-MM-DD, optional; server default today).

tools.name: inventory_reconciliation-ledgers
tools.description: BP ledgers behind the Wellness-Mart reconciliation, pivoted by document-type origin for each side (Mart vs Wellness). Optional: schema, date_from, date_to.

tools.name: inventory_stock
tools.description: Live finished-goods on-hand stock for one company: type summaries + per-SKU x per-warehouse rows. Optional: schema.

tools.name: masterdata_calculator-items
tools.description: SAP finished-goods item master for the realise-calculator picker (code, name, variety, sku, pcs/box, box litres).

tools.name: masterdata_customer-master
tools.description: Entire customer master (contact, tax, address, terms, credit limit, balance, status) in one payload. code is the join key.

tools.name: masterdata_rate-list
tools.description: Saved realise-calculator results (rate lists). Pass --id to fetch a single saved result. Optional: id.

params.name: id
params.description: Return only the saved result with this id (optional; omit to list all).

tools.name: oih_breakdown
tools.description: Line-level OIH breakdown, one row per open SO line, split premium vs commodity value and pieces.

tools.name: oih_commodity-rows
tools.description: OIH open-order rows filtered to commodity oils (u_type=COMMODITY). Optional: start, end.

tools.name: oih_rows
tools.description: OIH as individual open-order rows (open litres per item/customer). Optional: start, end.

tools.name: oih_summary
tools.description: Total OIH value summarised per salesperson.

tools.name: sales_beverages
tools.description: BEVERAGES dataset feed: beverage sales lines, day-over-day box comparison, customer grading, month rollup and beverage OIH. Required: start_date, end_date.

tools.name: sales_beverages-docs
tools.description: Documents (invoices / SOs) behind a beverages node — lazily fetched per drilled node. Required: metric, start, end. Optional: f_brand, f_ym.

params.name: metric
params.description: Node measure, e.g. quantity | boxes | oih.

tools.name: sales_channel-docs
tools.description: Documents behind a Slide-2 channel card cell — invoices (done) or open SOs (oih), with per-line items and per-warehouse stock. Optional: channel, metric, seg (plus 8 more).

params.name: channel
params.description: Channel / main-group code (GT, MT, ECOM...); empty = all.

params.name: metric
params.description: done (invoices) or oih (open SOs). Default done.

tools.name: sales_cn
tools.description: Line-level gross sales vs credit-note rows for one company (oil|beverages) over a date range. Required: start_date, end_date. Optional: company.

tools.name: sales_compare-docs
tools.description: Invoice-level drill-down behind a Compare-Sales pivot cell (one month range plus optional dimension filters). Required: start_date, end_date. Optional: seg, group, state (plus 4 more).

params.name: end_date
params.description: Last day of the clicked month (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: sales_data
tools.description: Core OILS realise feed: per-product litres/₹/realise/target rows plus flattened channel + month line-item rows for a date range. Required: start_date, end_date. Optional: refresh.

params.name: start_date
params.description: Range start (YYYY-MM-DD). Use a single day to sample.

tools.name: sales_dispatch
tools.description: Per-invoice physical dispatch / freight metadata (bilty, transporter, vehicle, driver) for a date range. Required: start_date, end_date.

tools.name: sales_drill-down
tools.description: Expand one Slide-1 product row into a chosen dimension (litres + linetotal per value). drill_by is case-sensitive (State|U_Main_Group|U_Chain|ItemName|CardName). Required: start_date, end_date, u_type, u_sub_group, drill_by. Optional: filters, month, year.

params.name: drill_by
params.description: Pascal-case dimension: State | U_Main_Group | U_Chain | ItemName | CardName.

params.name: filters
params.description: Accumulated parent-drill path filters as JSON, e.g. {'State':'HARYANA'}; {} at top level.

tools.name: sales_flow
tools.description: Sales document chains (Quotation -> Order -> Invoice) with open/closed status and source, for a date range and company. Required: start_date, end_date. Optional: company.

tools.name: sales_flow-open-items
tools.description: Drill-down: still-open line items of a single open Sales Order or Quotation. Required: doc_type, doc_no. Optional: company.

params.name: company
params.description: oil (default) or beverages — must match the row.

tools.name: sales_hidden
tools.description: Hidden sales-invoice lines (SAP U_ARNO='H') over a date range — oil company only. Required: start_date, end_date.

tools.name: sales_historical
tools.description: Trailing-period average realise (₹/L) per product and per drilled dimension, as a Slide-1 overlay. Required: start_date, end_date. Optional: period.

tools.name: sales_pulse
tools.description: Cheap change-fingerprint / heartbeat for the Realise backend (empty pulse = no signal). Detect change, not data. Optional: dataset, start, end.

tools.name: targets_channel
tools.description: Monthly target litres per sales channel (main group). Optional: month, year.

tools.name: targets_flex
tools.description: Flex (flat, dimension-scoped) litre targets — currently per salesperson — for the target month. Optional: seg, month, year.

tools.name: targets_list
tools.description: Product-level monthly targets (tgt_ltrs, tgt_rate, source) keyed by U_TYPE|SUB_GROUP. Optional: month, year.

tools.name: targets_nodes
tools.description: Granular target nodes: target litres by main_group x state x sales_person x segment for a month. Optional: month, year, seg.

tools.name: targets_segment
tools.description: Saved target overrides scoped to a single segment (empty {} when no overrides saved). Required: segment. Optional: month, year, seg.

params.name: segment
params.description: Segment name (server lower-cases it), e.g. OILS.

tools.name: users_catalog
tools.description: Permission-module catalog used by the Users page — read-only, from the page's embedded JSON.

tools.name: users_list
tools.description: Admin user list + roles/permission groups — read-only, from the page's embedded JSON.
